name: Aquaguard Enrich Hyde
summary: Aquaguard Enrich Hyde is a premium under-the-counter water purifier with an integrated single-unit design, advanced 10-stage RO+UV purification , Nanopore Long-Life Filter Technology , and 4-in-1 Active Copper Infusion .
intro: The Aquaguard Enrich Hyde is a premium under-the-counter water purifier featuring an integrated single-unit design with 10-stage RO+UV purification, Nanopore Long-Life Filter Technology, and 4-in-1 Active Copper Infusion. It removes harmful contaminants, enriches water with essential minerals, boosts alkalinity, and delivers safe, great-tasting drinking water from all water sources.
features: 10-Stage RO + UV Purification with Nanopore Long-Life Filter
4-in-1 Active Copper Infusion with Copper, Zinc, Calcium & Magnesium
Alkaline Boost Technology for BIS-standard alkaline water
NanoPore RO 2X removes heavy metals, pesticides, microplastics & industrial contaminants
UV e-Boiling Technology ensures water as pure as boiling for 20+ minutes
Integrated Under-the-Counter Design with wheels and grip handle
7-Litre Inline Storage Tank with refrigerator compatibility
Mega Sediment Filter extends filter life by trapping dust and mud
40%+ Water Recovery Technology for reduced water wastage
Suitable for Municipal, Borewell & Tanker Water (TDS up to 2000 mg/L)
1-Year Warranty, Free Installation & Genuine Aquaguard Service Plan

rows: i-Filter, Particle Trap Filter, Chemi-Block, HR RO Cartridge, UV e-Boiling, Active Copper + Alkaline Cartridge
